architecture.summary: SO-10 suspends idle free tenants and resumes them on the next call. The daily tenant sweeps gain the idle sweep of tenants (lifetime in app, between the Monday organization sweep and the fleet summary): it reads the live free rows whose last_active_at, or created_at when the tenant never served a call, is FREE_TENANT_IDLE_DAYS (new setting, 1 to 365, default 14, read only with MCP_TENANTS_ENABLED=true) or more before the tick, suspends each service through the Render adapter, and moves each row from live to suspended on the service that it read; team rows (another plan) are never read, and a suspend that Render does not take, also a 429, changes no row and gives one Tenant suspension failed line for the next sweep. App connects the resume operation of the gateway to resumeService of the same Render adapter instance (withTenantProvisioning now returns the storage and the resume, and GatewayStart.partsOn takes both), so the stub that always failed is gone; a failed resume, also a 429, moves the row back to suspended on the service of the mark. A deploying row that keeps its address, the row of a resume, answers 503 with Retry-After 60 in the gateway, and the claim of the provisioner takes such a row only 15 s after its resume mark, because right after a resume the newest deploy is still the live deploy from before the suspend (SO-09 record) and Render makes the resume deploy about 2 s after the call; this is a time bound, not a deploy identity, which the answer of a resume does not give. The state-only writes bind to the observed service (manager decision of 31 October 2026): restoreSuspended(organizationId, serviceId) and recordFailed(organizationId, serviceId, reason), with a creating row binding to NULL. New external use from the server: Render suspend and resume (10 a minute for each service). New contracts: the setting, the log lines Idle sweep, Idle sweep stopped, Tenant suspension record, Tenant suspension failed, and the 503 with Retry-After 60 until a resumed tenant is live. Availability changes: an idle free tenant stops, and its first call waits about a minute. No new component, container, public module, dependency, migration, or deployment unit; the TenantPlatform contract is unchanged, so the Render adapter is unchanged. Five registry views change: the tenant registry view (idle sweep, suspend and resume calls, idle read and suspended mark), the gateway call scenario (a resumed deploying row), the weekly organization sweep scenario (its tick note), and two new scenarios, the daily idle sweep and the resume of a suspended tenant. The portal notice of a suspended tenant waits for SO-07 (#293), which defines the workspace status route.
